salmanshh_line_renderer.name: Line Renderer
salmanshh_line_renderer.description: Draw a Sprite or Tiled Background as a line, rope or beam along a path of points using mesh distortion, in 2D or 3D.

initialPointCount.name: Initial point count
initialPointCount.desc: The number of points the line starts with. They are spread across the object so it initially looks unchanged.

coordSpace.name: Co-ordinate space
coordSpace.desc: Absolute uses layout co-ordinates. Relative uses co-ordinates relative to the object's position, angle and size, so the line moves with the object.

uvScrollSpeed.name: Texture scroll speed
uvScrollSpeed.desc: How fast the image scrolls along the line, in pixels per second (Tiled Background only).

endCapStyle.name: End caps
endCapStyle.desc: The shape of the start and end of the line. None cuts off at the end point; Square and Round extend by half the thickness.

ribbonFacing.name: Facing
ribbonFacing.desc: How the width of the line is oriented in 3D. Flat stays in the layout plane, Billboard faces the camera, Up vector follows the up vector.

distortAmplitude.name: Distortion amplitude
distortAmplitude.desc: The maximum offset of the distortion wave, in pixels. 0 disables distortion.

distortFrequency.name: Distortion frequency
distortFrequency.desc: The frequency of the distortion wave along the line.

distortSpeed.name: Distortion speed
distortSpeed.desc: How fast the distortion wave moves along the line.

distortAxis.name: Distortion axis
distortAxis.desc: The direction the distortion wave moves points in.

distortResolution.name: Distortion resolution
distortResolution.desc: The number of mesh subdivisions per segment. Increase for smoother distortion on long segments.

autoFit.name: Auto-fit to line
autoFit.desc: Move and resize the object to cover the line after each update (absolute co-ordinate space only). Keeps collisions and on-screen checks accurate for long lines.

joinStyle.name: Joins
joinStyle.desc: How corners between segments are drawn. Simple is cheapest but thins at corners, Miter is sharp, Bevel is chipped, Round is rounded.

crossSection.name: Cross-section points
crossSection.desc: The number of points around the line. 2 draws a flat ribbon; 3 or more draws a 3D tube (joins become Simple).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the behavior is initially enabled.

SetBillboardCamera.description: Set the camera position used by Billboard facing, either from the 3D camera automatically or from a position.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Automatic uses the 3D Camera object. Manual uses the position below.

SetCrossSection.description: Set the number of points around the line: 2 draws a flat ribbon, 3 or more draws a 3D tube.

points.name: Points
points.desc: The number of points around the cross-section (2 for a ribbon, 3 to 32 for a tube).

SetEndCapStyle.description: Set the shape of the start and end of the line.

style.name: End caps
style.desc: None cuts off at the end point. Square and Round extend by half the thickness.

SetJoinStyle.description: Set how corners between segments are drawn.

style.name: Joins
style.desc: Simple, Miter, Bevel or Round corners.

SetRibbonFacing.description: Set how the width of the line is oriented in 3D.

facing.name: Facing
facing.desc: Flat stays in the layout plane, Billboard faces the camera, Up vector follows the up vector.

SetUpVector.description: Set the up direction used by Up vector facing. The default (0, 0, 1) points up in Z elevation.

x.name: X
x.desc: The X component of the up vector.

y.name: Y
y.desc: The Y component of the up vector.

z.name: Z
z.desc: The Z component of the up vector.

SetUVScrollSpeed.description: Set how fast the image scrolls along the line (Tiled Background only).

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: The scroll speed along the line, in pixels per second.

FitObjectToLine.description: Move and resize the object once so that it covers the line (absolute co-ordinate space only).

SetAutoFit.description: Enable or disable moving and resizing the object to cover the line after each update (absolute co-ordinate space only).

SetCoordSpace.description: Set whether points are in layout co-ordinates (absolute) or relative to the object (relative).

space.name: Co-ordinate space
space.desc: Absolute uses layout co-ordinates. Relative uses co-ordinates relative to the object's position, angle and size.

SetDistortAmplitude.description: Set the maximum offset of the distortion wave. 0 disables distortion.

amplitude.name: Amplitude
amplitude.desc: The maximum offset of the wave, in pixels.

SetDistortAxis.description: Set the direction the distortion wave moves points in.

axis.name: Axis
axis.desc: The direction of the distortion offset.

SetDistortFrequency.description: Set the frequency of the distortion wave along the line.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.desc: The frequency of the wave along the line.

SetDistortion.display-text: Set {my} distortion to amplitude {0}, frequency {1}, speed {2}
SetDistortion.description: Set the amplitude, frequency and speed of the distortion wave.

amplitude.name: Amplitude
amplitude.desc: The maximum offset of the wave, in pixels. 0 disables distortion.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.desc: The frequency of the wave along the line.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: How fast the wave moves along the line.

SetDistortSpeed.description: Set how fast the distortion wave moves along the line.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: How fast the wave moves along the line.

SetPointsFromObjects.description: Replace all points with the positions of the picked instances of an object, one point per instance.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object whose picked instances become the points.

SetPointToImagePoint.display-text: Set {my} point {0} to {1} image point {3} on face {2}
SetPointToImagePoint.description: Set a point to the position of an image point of the first picked instance, including its Z elevation. Choose a face for 3D shape face image points.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object to take the image point from.

face.name: Face
face.desc: The 3D shape face the image point is on, or None for other objects.

name.name: Image point
name.desc: The name or number of the image point (0 is the origin).

SetPointToNode.description: Set a point to the position of a mesh or bone node of the first picked 3D model instance.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The 3D model object to take the node from.

nodeType.name: Node type
nodeType.desc: Whether the node name refers to a mesh or a bone.

SetPointToObject.description: Set a point to the position and Z elevation of the first picked instance of an object.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object to take the position from.

BuildArc.display-text: Set {my} arc at ({0}, {1}) radius {2} from {3} to {4} degrees with {5} segments
BuildArc.description: Replace all points with an arc around a position.

cx.name: Center X
cx.desc: The X co-ordinate of the center of the arc.

cy.name: Center Y
cy.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the center of the arc.

radius.name: Radius
radius.desc: The radius of the arc, in pixels.

segments.name: Segments
segments.desc: The number of straight segments used for the arc.

BuildBezier.display-text: Set {my} bezier curve from ({0}, {1}) via ({2}, {3}) and ({4}, {5}) to ({6}, {7}) with {8} segments
BuildBezier.description: Replace all points with a cubic bezier curve.

x1.name: Start X
x1.desc: The X co-ordinate of the start of the curve.

y1.name: Start Y
y1.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the start of the curve.

c1x.name: Control 1 X
c1x.desc: The X co-ordinate of the first control point.

c1y.name: Control 1 Y
c1y.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the first control point.

c2x.name: Control 2 X
c2x.desc: The X co-ordinate of the second control point.

c2y.name: Control 2 Y
c2y.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the second control point.

x2.name: End X
x2.desc: The X co-ordinate of the end of the curve.

y2.name: End Y
y2.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the end of the curve.

segments.name: Segments
segments.desc: The number of straight segments used for the curve.

ConnectObjects.description: Replace all points with a straight line between the first picked instances of two objects.

from.name: From
from.desc: The object to start the line at.

to.name: To
to.desc: The object to end the line at.

SetLine.description: Replace all points with a straight line between two positions.

x1.name: Start X
x1.desc: The X co-ordinate of the start of the line.

y1.name: Start Y
y1.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the start of the line.

x2.name: End X
x2.desc: The X co-ordinate of the end of the line.

y2.name: End Y
y2.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the end of the line.

SetLine3D.description: Replace all points with a straight line between two positions with Z elevations.

x1.name: Start X
x1.desc: The X co-ordinate of the start of the line.

y1.name: Start Y
y1.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the start of the line.

z1.name: Start Z elevation
z1.desc: The Z elevation of the start of the line.

x2.name: End X
x2.desc: The X co-ordinate of the end of the line.

y2.name: End Y
y2.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the end of the line.

z2.name: End Z elevation
z2.desc: The Z elevation of the end of the line.

SmoothPath.description: Replace the points with a smooth curve passing through them.

subdivisions.name: Subdivisions
subdivisions.desc: The number of points added between each pair of existing points.

SetDistortResolution.description: Set the number of mesh subdivisions per segment used for distortion.

subdivisions.name: Subdivisions
subdivisions.desc: The number of mesh subdivisions per segment (at least 1).

SetFrustumCulling.description: Enable or disable skipping line updates while the line is off-screen.

SetRenderLOD.description: Limit how many points are used to draw the line. 0 uses all points.

maxPoints.name: Maximum points
maxPoints.desc: The maximum number of points used to draw the line, or 0 for all.

SetAllWidths.display-text: Set {my} width of all points to {0}
SetAllWidths.description: Set the width of the line at every point.

width.name: Width
width.desc: Half the thickness of the line, in pixels.

index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

x.name: X

y.name: Y

width.name: Width

width.name: Width

SetPointXY.description: Set the position of a point.

x.desc: The X co-ordinate of the point.

y.name: Y

width.name: Width
